text: My read: **Trellis (ADR-0075) is a reconciliation substrate for the reactive *read* side** — graph transactions, dependency identity, collection diffs, scoped teardown, output-frame lifecycle, deterministic replay — living *below typed read sessions*. The wallet operation journal is a different animal: a **durable write-side saga** (`Draft→MintPending→MintSettled→PublishPending→Settled/Unknown/Failed`) whose whole job is crash-recovery and reconciling against *external* authority (the mint) so no double-spend/double-pay survives process death.
